channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Supreme Court stays University Grants Commission Promotion of Equity Regulations 2026
item.description: The Supreme Court has paused the UGC’s new equity regulations, questioning their clarity, inclusiveness and constitutional validity amid growing campus protests.

item.title: From Ice to National Pride: Indian Army Clinches Men’s Ice Hockey Gold at Khelo India Winter Games 2026
item.description: A tense final in Leh saw the Indian Army edge Chandigarh 3–2, spotlighting the rapid rise of winter sports in India.

item.title: Killed Over a Matchstick: How a Trivial Beedi Dispute Cost a 21-Year-Old His Life in Delhi
item.description: A minor dispute over lighting a beedi escalated into fatal violence, exposing deeper social fault lines in urban Delhi.

item.title: BNP Audit Finds Majority of Bengaluru’s Public Toilets Unusable Due to Poor Maintenance
item.description: A three-month audit by the BNP across 21 wards has exposed systemic neglect, revealing that only 45% of Bengaluru’s public toilets are functional while safety and accessibility remain alarmingly poor.

item.title: PM Modi Urges Quality Focus As India Concludes Historic Trade Pact With European Union
item.description: Prime Minister Modi urges Indian manufacturers to prioritise quality as the historic India-EU trade deal opens new markets.

item.title: Kerala Budget 2026–27 Promises ₹14,500 Crore for Pensions, Hikes Pay for ASHA and Anganwadi Workers
item.description: The 2026–27 Kerala Budget reinforces welfare commitments with higher pensions, increased ASHA and Anganwadi pay, and expanded social support schemes.

item.title: Economic Survey 2025–26: India’s Growth Seen at 6.8–7.2% in FY27 Amid Global Uncertainty
item.description: The Economic Survey 2025–26 forecasts moderated but stable growth for India in FY27, driven by domestic demand amid global uncertainty.

item.title: From A Confined Home To 400 Farmers: How Shobha Devi’s Agri Enterprise Is Transforming Rural Lives
item.description: A rural woman’s leap into agri-entrepreneurship shows how training, support, and confidence can transform communities.

item.title: Indian Rupee Hits Record Low Of 92 Against US Dollar Amid Global Economic Volatility
item.description: Indian Rupee breaches historic 92 mark against US Dollar as global headwinds and capital outflows intensify.

item.title: Amid Heavy Snowfall, Jammu and Kashmir Doctor Rides JCB to Reach Patients, Inspires Many
item.description: Amid crippling snowfall in south Kashmir’s Shopian, a government doctor used an excavator to reach hospital and perform urgent surgeries, exposing both dedication and systemic gaps.
